logo_directions: A court-arc JV ligature: one bold continuous geometric stroke forms a clear J on the left and an ascending V on the right, inspired by the curve of a tennis-ball seam and the precise angle of a service court. Flat ivory mark with one chartreuse terminal dot, very simple, identifiable at 24px.

A stringbed JV monogram: four precisely spaced diagonal string lines interlock into unmistakable J and V initials inside an elegant rounded square. Minimal ivory geometry, one chartreuse crossing point. Fine but readable at small sizes.

A flight JV symbol: a bold forward-leaning J stroke joins a sharp V trajectory, with a single tennis-ball dot finishing the path. Athletic understated ivory symbol, chartreuse dot. No wings or racket silhouette.
A baseline JV symbol: crisp orthogonal court baseline folds into a J, then a broad angular V. Simple strong ivory architectural monogram with chartreuse horizontal baseline, no gradients.

Below provider row official simple Google Drive icon and "Google Drive" pill "Connected · Demo". Backup preference toggles "Back up originals" on, "Wi-Fi only" on. Visible "Upload queue" rows "Jon vs Alex" "Uploading · 62%" and "Serve practice" "Waiting for Wi-Fi"; one explicit retry text "Forehand session · Retry backup". Lower "Export video + analysis" link. Small note "Backup storage does not run analysis". Forest "Manage storage". Sample state label. Sample device capacity 256 GB, used 12.4 GB, free 243.6 GB.
screens.shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. One single premium iOS app screen for JOVRA Tennis. Output a flat straight-on full-bleed portrait UI screenshot approximately 1170 by 2532 pixels, no phone hardware, no perspective, no external captions or surrounding poster. Brand reference image establishes the exact JOVRA wordmark and Court Arc JV mark. Design: warm ivory #F4F1E8 backgrounds, deep forest #092A25 and panels #123C33, tennis-chartreuse #D7F56A accents, charcoal #182F29 typography, warm clay #C47752 only for flagged items. Restrained premium tennis club mixed with precision sports instrument; excellent hierarchy, exquisite generous whitespace, fine chart gridlines, crisp SF Pro-like sans typography, tabular large numerals, 8-point spacing, 22px card corners, native iOS status bar 9:41 and home indicator. Dark screens use forest background and ivory type. No neon cyberpunk, no rainbow gradients, no glass card overload, no tiny dense text. Realistic original court/player photography where requested. Main labels must be crisp and accurate. All metrics and photos are illustrative reference content, not implemented product. Only draw controls specified for this screen.

screens.title: Settings, Apple permissions and privacy
screens.final_specification: Heading "Settings" small JOVRA. Native grouped settings on ivory: account row "Jon" "Apple sign-in". Section "Recording": "Camera" "Allowed"; "Microphone" "Optional · Off"; "Photos" "Selected photos"; each chevron, small link "Open iOS Settings". "Preferences": "Units" "mph · lb"; "Appearance" "System"; "Accessibility" chevron. "Privacy & data": "Training data sharing" toggle Off; "Export my data"; "Delete account" subdued red. "Support": "Recording help". Tiny footer "JOVRA · Reference concept". No fake custom iOS permission dialog, no priced subscription.
